newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan offers HCEBL for privatisation.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan offers HCEBL for privatisation.

text.p: Pakistan's Privatisation Commission said on Thursday it had invited expressions of interest by January 15 for the sale of 70 percent of the shares of Habib Credit and Exchange Bank Ltd (HCEBL).
The HCEBL was established to take over the collapsed Bank of Credit and Commerce International (BCCI) in Pakistan.
The three HCEBL branches in Karachi, Lahore and Rawalpindi are 100 percent owned by the state-run Habib Bank Ltd.
The HCEBL has paid-up capital and reserves of 693 million rupees, total assets of 13.356 billion and an audited annual pretax profit of 265.524 million rupees as on December 1995.
